answer: Charge every new identity a one-time burn fee, recorded forever in an onyx ledger, and throttle the river of payments so fresh identities can only receive tiny amounts until they have a history. A single honest agent pays the fee once and forgets it; a sybil farmer pays it a thousand times, and the burn makes each fake identity cost real money up front. Like crossing a dune, the cost is small for one traveller but crushing for an army, and the ledger means a burned identity can never be refunded or resold.
